subject: CAMPAIGN GOAL: the sentiment pipeline tells the truth on every surface it draws, in the order this card holds
activeForm: Working the board in priority order
description:
THE GOAL. Every surface this service draws is currently lying in a different way: the chart pins near +1.0 because fanout discards sign, its source selector renders one identical line in four modes, the frontend keeps the previous series when a mode returns empty, and the digest labels every ticker neutral because its queries throw. Above them sits a deploy gate that cannot fail and a pre-push security gate that reports zero while alerts are open. Work the cards until each surface shows measured data or an honest empty state, and until a broken deploy or an open alert is stopped by a gate rather than by a reader noticing.

UPDATE DISCIPLINE. New scope is appended here as discovered; finished items are deleted, not annotated. Cards are canon for their own content; this list is canon for ordering. On main, update this file in the same commit that adds, trims or deletes a card. On a card branch it is not yours to write: report the board change you need in your final message and Helios makes it.

THE LIFECYCLE IS HYDROSTAT. Canon is ~/dotfiles/docs/hydrostat.md and it is not copied here. The machine is installed once on this host as `hydrostat` and `card-start` on PATH and serves every repository; .hydrostat.json at this root tunes it. `hydrostat <id>` is the one button and `hydrostat <id> --query` looks without stepping.

READY TO RUN NOW, nothing blocking them: 12, 8, 1, 7, 10, 11, 13.

OPERATOR ACTIONS OWED, named by card 8's attestation and fixable nowhere in this repo. TIINGO_API_KEY and FINNHUB_API_KEY do not exist; until they are created the 22 @external-api tests run in zero CI contexts and nightly-e2e reports green having run nothing. And the next deploy wants watching: the 16 sanity tests have never executed against preprod, so if preprod does not serve OHLC they now FAIL rather than skip and test-preprod goes red. That is the gate working.

PRIORITY ORDER.
1. Card 12 (stale spec allocator). Ranked first because it is the one defect that damages OTHER cards: this repo's vendored .specify/scripts/bash/create-new-feature.sh predates card 126, allocates by local scan, and runs `git checkout -b`, which from a card worktree moves a Dynamo off its own branch mid-work. Every future Dynamo following speckit.specify.md hits it. Workaround until it lands: invoke ~/dotfiles/.specify/scripts/bash/create-new-feature.sh with the card's own specNumber, which is what card 8 did to mint specs/1401.
2. Card 8 REMAINDER (constitution-prune doc audit). The deploy-gate half SHIPPED on 2026-09-22 as 596b07e8 and the gate can now fail; specs/1401-deploy-gate-can-fail/spec.md records it. What is left is the stash-B doc audit and the BATTLEPLAN deferred items, which is documentation work at a different risk profile. NOTE the correction it returned: stash-A is not merely committed as a patch file, it is APPLIED in the tree. Only stash-B is unapplied, and it is measured not applying against three drifted anchors.
3. Card 1 (signed-fanout). Implemented on branch 001-signed-fanout, PR #1032 open with checks green. Remaining: merge, the admin bootstrap apply for the backfill IAM role, and the data backfill on separate per-environment operator go. Unblocks 2, 4, 5 and 6, which is most of the board.
4. Card 10 (pre-push gate reports 0 while 21 are open). Small, independent, and it is the gate every other card's push passes through. Worth landing early for that reason alone.
5. Card 2 (source attribution always 'dedup:'). Kills the chart's source modes at the root.
6. Card 3 (chart keeps a stale series). Small fix, but decide it WITH card 2: once real sources flow, empty modes get rarer and silence is still a lie.
7. Card 4 (digest never worked). Check whether digest emails currently ship to anyone before spending on it.
8. Card 5 (finance-native model swap). Research is DONE, no re-derivation owed.
9. Card 6 (live README hero). Commissioned as a battleplan with a research component. The static hero it succeeds is already shipped and in README.md:7.
10. Card 11 (QUARRYSOME closeout). One audit from v1-done. Stays open by standing operator decision until its work items land.
11. Card 9 (specs tree hygiene). Blocked by 1, 8, 10 and 11 on purpose: its sweep adjudicates the specs/ dirs those cards still occupy, so it runs last among them.
12. Card 7 (re-add CloudWatch alarms). Blocked on the operator deciding alarms are wanted again. The deletion was a cost call, not a verdict.

STANDING, NOT ORDERED. cards/improve-local.json is this repo's improve-local inbox: a dump target, never a queue position. File with `improve-drop.sh local` and batch with `improve-collect.py local` from this root checkout.

SPEC DIRS WITH NO CARD, MEASURED SHIPPED 2026-09-22. Each was checked against the tree rather than against its own status line, which still says Draft in several cases. They need no card and card 9's sweep disposes of the dirs: 001-makefile-hardening (terraform 1.9.8 pinned in .terraform-version, check-iam-patterns BLOCKING at Makefile:89, cost-check and infracost targets live), 001-makefile-compose-repair (COMPOSE = docker compose at Makefile:236 with the loud preflight at 248-251), 001-secrets-wrapper-normalize (volatile-vs-substantive logic live in scripts/detect-secrets-autostage.sh:9-10,45,49,78-91), 001-eslint-9-flat-config (eslint ^9 and frontend/eslint.config.mjs, no .eslintrc, next ^16.2.12), 001-readme-landing (hero at README.md:7), 001-md-overhaul (phase-6 closeout PASS; SC-004 re-measured 14,337 against its 35,055 ceiling), 001-makefile-stale-shortlist (input document to 001-md-overhaul).

13. Card 13 (skills reachable from one harness only). Small, and it is why a reported defect is worth verifying against the harness rather than the directory shape.

CROSS-BOARD, no action owed. scottgoscott's cards/3.json targets this repo for a portfolio pass (three chaos scenarios and a README pass, its specs/0007). It is not running and not scheduled, and its own card records that it cannot sensibly run while this board's surfaces are still being corrected. If this board reaches its goal and the pass is wanted, say so through the board inbox and scottgoscott's Helios sequences it.

OTHER OPEN LOOSE ENDS. PR #1035 (remove cloudwatch alarms) and PR #866 (fix 2 vacuous E2E tests, open since 2026-04-05) are both open and unmerged; decide merge or close.
